compose.name: fivem
compose.description: FiveM (Cfx.re) server with txAdmin built-in. Port 30120 = game client port (TCP+UDP), 40120 = txAdmin web UI. Connects to MariaDB via 'operator' component (Flux-Shared-DB) at host=operator port=3307 db=fivem — set in txAdmin's Database screen after boot.

compose.name: mariadb
compose.description: MariaDB 10.6 (LTS) backing store for FiveM. Pinned to 10.6 — MariaDB 10.10+ UCA1400 collations break the mysql2 driver oxmysql uses. Reached only via the Flux-Shared-DB Operator (component 'operator') which keeps it synced across instances.

userEnvironmentParameters.name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
userEnvironmentParameters.description: MySQL root password. The Flux-Shared-DB Operator and your RP framework (qbcore/esx/qbox) both authenticate with this password. MUST match the value you enter for DB_INIT_PASS on the operator component. Use a strong random password (16+ chars).

compose.name: operator
compose.description: Flux-Shared-DB Operator. Exposes MySQL at hostname operator port 3307 (enter manually under txAdmin's Database options). Replicates writes across all your FiveM instances on the Flux network.

userEnvironmentParameters.name: DB_INIT_PASS
userEnvironmentParameters.description: Operator's auth password to MySQL. MUST match the value you enter for MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD on the mariadb component.

userEnvironmentParameters.name: SSL_PASSPHRASE

userEnvironmentParameters.name: STREAMR__BROKER__PLUGINS__AUTOSTAKER__MAX_SPONSORSHIP_COUNT
userEnvironmentParameters.description: **OPTIONAL** The integer maxSponsorshipCount controls how many sponsorships the autostaker will stake into at most. The larger the capacity of your operator fleet state is (in terms of node count / CPU / bandwidth) the higher this number can be. Conversely, if your operator fleet is small, this integer should be kept low. The default value is set to 25.

userEnvironmentParameters.name: STREAMR__BROKER__PLUGINS__AUTOSTAKER__MIN_TRANSACTION_DATA_TOKEN_AMOUNT
userEnvironmentParameters.description: **OPTIONAL** The integer minTransactionDataTokenAmount controls the minimum value a transaction must be to be considered for execution. The value is expressed in $DATA tokens. Any transactions falling below this value will be skipped. This is to avoid executing transactions that are too small in value. To choose this value, balance the cost of gas vs. the value gained by staking the amount optimally. (The exception to this config is expired sponsorships, which will always be unstaked from regardless.) The default value is set to 1000.

userEnvironmentParameters.name: STREAMR__BROKER__PLUGINS__AUTOSTAKER__MAX_ACCEPTABLE_MIN_OPERATOR_COUNT
userEnvironmentParameters.description: **OPTIONAL** The integer maxAcceptableMinOperatorCount is used to decide whether to stake into a sponsorship that has a minimum operator count requirement. Such sponsorships only start paying out once the minimum operator count is reached. E.g. if a sponsorship has a minimum operator count of 20, and this is set to 20, the autostaker will stake into it. If it is set to 10, the autostaker will not stake into it. (The check is static and does not consider how many operators may currently already be staked into such a sponsorship.) The default value is set to 50.

userEnvironmentParameters.name: STREAMR__BROKER__PLUGINS__AUTOSTAKER__RUN_INTERVAL_IN_MS
userEnvironmentParameters.description: **OPTIONAL** The integer runIntervalInMs controls how often the autostaker will run its logic. In addition to time-based runs, the autostaker will also run whenever a new sponsorship is created. The default value is set to 3600000, and the value must be >= 300000.
